# TASK-252: Harden folder selection and export handoff

## Goal

Remove the crash-prone open/save panel dependency from monitored-root configuration and make the completed evidence directory open automatically after export.

## Deliverables

- In-app native folder browser
- Watched and excluded root commit flow
- Completed evidence-directory Finder handoff
- Interaction regression tests

## Allowed Write Scope

- Sources/DiskStewardApp/MonitoringUI/**
- Sources/DiskStewardApp/StatusItemController.swift
- Sources/DiskStewardApp/StatusBoardViewModel.swift
- Tests/DiskStewardAppTests/Settings/**
- Tests/DiskStewardAppTests/Export/**
- Tests/IncrementTests/Application/**
- docs/tasks/evidence/TASK-252/**

## Non-Goals

- Deleting user files or evidence exports
- Changing evidence contents or MCP semantics
- Depending on the macOS open/save panel service

- None

- TASK-220 settings surface
- TASK-251 export path
- MonitoringSettingsView and MonitoringSettingsStore

- swift test --filter 'MonitoringSettingsTests|StatusBoardEvidenceExportTests'

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-252-01` — Watched and excluded roots are chosen through an in-app native folder browser that does not instantiate NSOpenPanel or the crashing openAndSavePanelService, accepts an arbitrary readable directory, persists the standardized path exactly once, and supports cancel without mutation.
- `AC-252-02` — A successful Export Current Evidence action opens the completed evidence directory itself in Finder after all bundle files are committed; cancellation, unavailable storage, or export failure does not open Finder.
- `AC-252-03` — Focused tests cover folder navigation and commit semantics, watched-root persistence, export success/failure handoff, and the product remains buildable on macOS 13 or newer.

## Required Evidence

- `EVREQ-252-01` (interaction-regression-test) — Automated folder-selection and export-completion tests plus a launched-app rehearsal showing a non-default watched root added without an open/save service crash and the completed export directory opened in Finder.
